description: This file defines a PHP class 'Redis' that provides caching functionalities using Redis as the backend. It includes methods for connecting to Redis, getting, setting, and deleting cache entries, with support for expiration handling.

classes.name: Redis
classes.description: A cache management class utilizing Redis for storage, with methods for get, set, and delete operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes Redis connection and sets default expiration time.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by key, decoding JSON stored data.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache with optional expiration, encoding it as JSON.
